""custom images must include python3." >&2; exit 1; fi; export SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_RUNPOD="${SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_RUNPOD:-0.0.0.dev0}"; RUNTIME_SPEC="${RUNPOD_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_SPEC:-runpod-sdk-runtime}"; if [ -n "${RUNPOD_RUNTIME_PACKAGE_SPEC:-}" ] || ! "$PY" -c "import runpod" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$PY" -m pip install -q --upgrade "$SDK_SPEC" || exit 1; fi; exec "$PY" -m runpod_sdk_runtime.bootstrap'
